verdict_reason: Branch scenarios and links are gone consistently with the spec and the renamed links resolve, but SCN-INS-ADDR-037-H's rewritten update half is claimed full with no update test, and two link notes still count the removed Branch/contact runs.

todos.fix: Must: a test proves a PUT with roles from two groups returns 400 keyed by roles and the stored roles are unchanged, and it is linked on SCN-INS-ADDR-037-H; until then the scenario and REQ-INS-ADDR-037 are rated from what the links prove. One way: add AddressUpdateIT put_shouldReturn400KeyedByRolesAndKeepStoredValues_whenTheRolesComeFromTwoGroups (IMPORTER + CONSIGNOR on an IMPORTER address), red-probe it, and link it.
